notes: Skill evolutions: max out a skill with its partner passive to evolve it into a stronger form (see the new Codex)
Cat Form is now pure melee: Shadowcat sheds ranged nature spells and refunds the levels as free picks
New Sanguine Maw talent: Cat Form claws heal you (lifesteal)
Damage meter: see which skill does the most damage, live and in the end-of-run summary
Exit Run from the pause menu, and a Quit Game button in the desktop app
Full controller play: every menu, card and dialog works with a gamepad
Solid obstacles: stumps, gravestones and ruined walls now block movement
